environment_setting: Country B, Suburban neighborhood, where family values are highly emphasized, and social norms discourage public disputes or illegal activities within families.

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: maintain family harmony while resolving financial stress

legitimate.legitimate_action: Discussing financial issues calmly with spouse and seeking professional advice
legitimate.benefits: Improved communication with spouse, potential resolution of financial stress
legitimate.costs: Time and effort spent on discussions and consultations

character_profile.name: Emily Smith
character_profile.goal: Ensure family stability and ethical behavior

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging John to seek professional help for financial issues

legitimate.costs: Emotional strain and time spent on discussions

illegal.illegal_action: Remaining silent while John commits theft in her presence

character_profile.name: Michael Johnson
